load_google_bleu_metric: load the google_bleu metric from the huggingface evaluate library
launch_gradio_widget: launch a gradio widget for the google_bleu evaluation metric
test_google_bleu_metric: test the google_bleu metric by loading it with evaluate.load
run_google_bleu_evaluation: run a google_bleu evaluation using the loaded evaluate module
review_google_bleu_metric: review the google_bleu metric loaded via evaluate.load for translation quality scoring
